evaluation.limitation: Repeated players and overlapping forecast windows are dependent. Weighted descriptive errors, not independent trials, causal estimates or a promotion gate.

assumptions.scoringScope: Existing weekly-model stat subset with league weights; not every platform scoring event is forecast.
